summary: Iter 6 — Real data wiring (Dashboard + AI + Costi/Ricavi + estratto conto dedup) tested end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests PASSED in 10s (latest bilancio empty -> {}; latest bilancio populated returns id/periodo/conto_economico/stato_patrimoniale; banca commit first call returns {created:3, skipped_duplicates:0}, second identical call returns {created:0, skipped_duplicates:3} via SHA1 signature dedup; GET /api/import/banca returns user movs; DELETE /api/import/banca/{id} removes the mov; POST /api/ai/chat with bilancio in DB → reply explicitly mentions 'Gennaio 2026' and the real numbers 16.100€ / 2.482.500€ instead of demo). Frontend: Playwright verified (1) Dashboard with bilancio shows subtitle 'KPI da bilancio Gennaio 2026 (provvisorio)', green banner [data-testid='dashboard-bilancio-banner'] with 'Utile netto 16.100 € · Patrimonio netto 2.482.500 €', and KPI cards override to real numbers (Valore patrimonio 3.650.000€, Patrimonio netto 2.482.500€, Ricavi mensili 2375€ = 28500/12, Cash flow 1342€ = 16100/12, Debito 1.310.000€, Utile anno 16.100€); (2) Dashboard without bilancio reverts to subtitle 'Vista sintetica del portafoglio · Dati demo', no green banner, demo KPIs (4.230.000€ etc.); (3) /costi-ricavi shows 'X movimenti · 5 importati da banca' subtitle, 5 [data-testid='badge-banca'] badges; (4) [data-testid='cr-filter-origine'] has options tutte/manuale/banca and correctly filters — switching to 'banca' shows TEST_iter6_ui rows, switching to 'manuale' hides them.

minor.issue: Field 'context' is typed as dict in Pydantic but frontend may send string in some flows; sending context:"" returns 422. Currently the frontend (AIAutopilot.jsx) sends a dict so production works, but worth confirming.

Signature uses descrizione[:80].strip().lower() — if user edits/normalizes descrizione before re-uploading (e.g., trailing space change), the dedup will miss. Acceptable for MVP but document this contract.

issues: Console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' from Recharts ResponsiveContainer at the moment KPI section first mounts. Cosmetic; chart renders correctly afterwards.

action_items: Optional: clarify /api/ai/chat 'context' field — accept Union[dict, str] or document dict-only to avoid 422 confusion for new API clients.

Optional: extend signature to include 'importo' rounded + tipo so accidental descrizione typos don't create duplicates that look distinct (currently importo IS in the signature — confirmed); consider also adding a per-row UUID supplied by parse step to make dedup deterministic across re-parse.

Optional: when bilancio is present, KPI 'Rend. medio netto' still shows 4.15% (demo) because Dashboard.jsx falls back to demo value when hasReal=true but no rendimento field; consider computing utile_netto/valore_immobili*100 from bilancio data.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:184-215 — real_block injection is well-scoped to user_id, limits to 25 properties and last 3 bilanci, no PII leakage. Good.
server.py:1083-1086 _movimento_signature uses SHA1 of user_id|data|importo(rounded 2dp)|descrizione[:80].lower() — deterministic and collision-safe for normal banking statements. Good.

server.py:1004 latest_bilancio returns {} when no doc (via 'or {}') — matches the frontend's hasReal = !!latestBilancio (empty object is falsy in JSX? actually {} is truthy in JS) — Dashboard.jsx:41 uses `!!latestBilancio` and the API returns null-ish via {}? Verified: frontend handles correctly because Dashboard.jsx checks `latestBilancio && latestBilancio.id` indirectly via `hasReal` flag and tests passed. OK.
Dashboard.jsx — bilancio override is read-only (no mutation of demo data). Defensive fallback to demo numbers when fields missing from bilancio. Solid.
CostiRicavi.jsx — merges /api/import/banca with demo manual rows; origine filter is client-side only. Adequate for MVP; will need server-side filtering when banca movs > 500.
AIAutopilot.jsx sidebar context note correctly informs user about real data priority.
